message.content:
To **log in to OneDrive**, go to the OneDrive sign-in page and enter the email address or phone number for your Microsoft account, then select **Next** and complete the password and any security verification prompts if shown.[1][7][10]

If you are signing in on a PC, you can also open the **OneDrive app** from the Start menu or taskbar, then choose **Sign in** and use the same Microsoft account.[2][5]

- Go to OneDrive sign-in.[1][10]
- Enter your Microsoft account email or phone number.[1][7]
- Enter your password.[3]
- Approve any security check or verification prompt.[2][4]
- If prompted, choose whether to stay signed in.[2][3]

If you want, I can also give you the steps for **Windows**, **Mac**, or **mobile** specifically.
